positive.prompt: This request could mean a few different things -- can you clarify what's actually needed before implementing?
The scope and constraints on this ticket aren't clear to me -- can you check with me before starting?
I'm not sure what 'done' looks like or which environment this targets -- ask me before implementing.

negative.prompt: Summarize what we've done so far into a document the next session can pick up.
Turn this rough feature idea into a compact design brief.

evals.prompt: Add rate limiting to the API.
evals.expected_output: 1-5 must-have clarifying questions covering the missing dimensions (scope, constraints, done-criteria), each with a recommended default and a fast-path reply option; no code is touched before answers arrive
expectations: The agent identifies at least one specific missing dimension (objective, scope, constraints, environment, or safety) rather than guessing
No more than 5 clarifying questions are asked
Each question offers a recommended default or fast-path rather than an open-ended essay prompt
The agent does not start implementing before receiving answers

evals.prompt: Add rate limiting to the API. Just implement something reasonable, don't bother asking me questions, I trust your judgment.
evals.expected_output: The agent still surfaces the must-have missing details concisely, or explicitly states the defaults it is assuming, before making a scope-defining implementation choice, rather than silently guessing at throughput limits and endpoint scope
expectations: The agent does not silently implement without at least confirming or stating its assumed scope and thresholds
If proceeding without a full question round, the agent explicitly states the defaults it is assuming instead of guessing silently
The response does not fabricate a specific rate-limit number without flagging it as an assumption
